This is a soreness-to-training-change request, but the athlete described a body part that aches and asked to avoid lunges and step-ups. Per the rules, that maps to a limitation without any comment on the hip. The vocabulary has no hip option, and I must not map an injury onto a limitation. The closest honest fit is a preference to avoid those movements, which the rules express via "knees" as a single-leg pattern limitation, but that would misstate the cause. The cleanest route is patch with no limitation guessed; instead I'll put lunges and step-ups in avoid, which is exactly what they named, and ask nothing further.

{"route": "patch", "say": "Got it, no lunges or step-ups in today's build.", "patch": {"avoid": ["lunges", "step ups"]}}
